children: Livepeer hosts its next Watercooler call live on the Livepeer Discord on November 3, 2026. The session provides a live project update for the community.

The call will demonstrate the new Livepeer Explorer. Users can use the Explorer to track their rewards and stake, and to participate in governance. The tool brings staking information and governance participation into one place.
Catch the next Watercooler live on the Livepeer Discord, Tuesday Nov 3:

title: Livepeer: Watercooler call features new Explorer demonstration - 03 Nov 2026
